theorems.name: Submission.dimred_tr_ida_density_on_carrier
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (V W : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep V n), IsOpen W → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → R.measure (K ∩ W) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)), x ∈ R.carrier ∩ W → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => R.measure (ball x ρ ∩ W) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (R.mult x : ℝ≥0∞))
